patch_description: This design combines direct-demand rewards with a congestion-aware, distributed two-hop relay signal. Unlike an unweighted reward for every possible two-hop path, each OD pair distributes a fixed amount of relay value across its candidate intermediates, favoring paths whose two links have lower estimated load. Estimated link load includes both direct traffic and a simple row/column-based transit proxy. This keeps the path terms sparse at O(n³) while reducing the tendency to reward many overlapping routes indiscriminately. The evaluator supplies degree penalties, so the returned penalty weight is set separately to encourage valid degree-two topologies.
